description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Verition is hiring a Quantitative Developer for one of its quantitative trading teams. The role develops tools and supports data pipelines, research, trading, risk management, execution, and predictive modeling.
Quantitative developer building Python research and trading tools, ensuring data integrity, and applying machine learning

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop various tools in Python that will be crucial for analysis, research, trading, and risk management purposes
• Ensure integrity of data management pipeline and the underlying data itself, and actively identify, diagnose, and remedy data issues
• Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements for existing systems and platforms
• Communicate regularly with team managers
• Collaborate cross-functionally with internal tech and data teams, researchers, traders, and outside vendors
• Commitment to safeguarding team information and adhering to business sensitivity
• Stay abreast of market trends and academic research to continually adapt and refine trading strategies
• Implement machine learning and other advanced techniques to enhance predictive accuracy

Requirements:
• At least 1-3 years experience in Python programming, ideally including libraries relevant to data analysis and machine learning
• A strong background in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming
• Exceptional analytical abilities and a strong problem-solving mindset
• Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with traders and other team members
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• High level of intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, and a keen attention to detail
• Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, fast-paced, and dynamic environment

Preferred:
• Ideally a degree in Computer Science or some other STEM program
• Experience with AWS or other cloud technology
• Knowledge of additional OOP languages like C++ or Java
• Familiarity with machine learning and AI applications in trading
